title: 吉隆坡雙子星塔
summary: 從核心筒與周邊柱環的側力分工、以混凝土重量換取低加速度出發，計算高強度混凝土圓柱的容量與空橋支腳的轉角，再處理避開石灰岩懸崖的塔位移動與深樁筏基、兩組承包商並行施工的幾何控制、高強度混凝土驗收與雙塔風洞干擾，最後是熱帶氣候下的外牆維護與空橋作為避難路徑的交接。
summaryEn: Starting from lateral load sharing between the core and the perimeter column ring and from trading concrete weight for low acceleration, compute the capacity of high-strength concrete columns and the rotation of the skybridge legs, then handle the site shift away from a limestone cliff onto deep piles and rafts, geometry control with two contractors working in parallel, high-strength concrete acceptance and twin-tower wind interference, ending with façade upkeep in a tropical climate and the handover of the skybridge as an escape route.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工」與「以重量換取低加速度」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube" and "Trading weight for low acceleration": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「核心筒與周邊柱環」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core and perimeter column ring” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 雙子星塔每座塔以約 23 m × 23 m 的鋼筋混凝土核心筒，加上一圈間距較大的圓形超級柱組成「管中管」系統，周邊柱以環梁連成框架筒，兩者經樓板共同抵抗側力。核心筒提供大部分剪力勁度，周邊框架筒則以較大的力臂提供抗傾覆能力；框架筒的效率取決於環梁勁度，環梁越柔，翼面柱子的軸力越受剪力滯後影響而無法充分發揮。選擇混凝土而非鋼構，部分原因是當時鋼材需進口、成本高，而高強度混凝土是在地承包商熟悉的材料。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「核心筒與周邊柱環」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each Petronas tower combines a reinforced concrete core of about 23 m × 23 m with a ring of widely spaced circular super columns in a tube-in-tube system; ring beams link the perimeter columns into a framed tube, and floors make the two work together against lateral load. The core supplies most of the shear stiffness while the perimeter tube, with its larger lever arm, supplies overturning resistance; the tube's efficiency depends on ring-beam stiffness, because flexible ring beams let shear lag keep flange columns from developing their full axial share. Concrete rather than steel was chosen partly because steel then had to be imported at high cost, while high-strength concrete was familiar to local contractors. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Core and perimeter column ring” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：有效慣性矩比較：核心 23 m 見方、牆厚 0.75 m，I_core = (23⁴ − 21.5⁴)/12 ≈ 5,514 m⁴；16 支直徑 2.4 m 圓柱位於半徑 22 m 圓周，完全共同作用時 I = A·n·R²/2 = 4.52×16×22²/2 ≈ 17,500 m⁴，若環梁柔度使效率 η = 0.3，有效 I ≈ 5,250 m⁴，周邊分擔約 49%；η = 0.5 時約 61%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Effective inertia comparison: a 23 m square core with 0.75 m walls has I_core = (23⁴ − 21.5⁴)/12 ≈ 5,514 m⁴; 16 columns of 2.4 m diameter on a 22 m radius would give I = A·n·R²/2 = 4.52×16×22²/2 ≈ 17,500 m⁴ if fully composite, but with ring-beam flexibility limiting efficiency to η = 0.3 the effective I is about 5,250 m⁴ and the perimeter share about 49%, rising to about 61% at η = 0.5.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「核心筒與周邊柱環」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Core and perimeter column ring”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「吉隆坡雙子星塔」的「高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「高樓模型整合室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube: mechanism and load path” in “Petronas Twin Towers”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tower model integration room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube" is correct?
options: 管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。
雙子星塔每座塔以約 23 m × 23 m 的鋼筋混凝土核心筒，加上一圈間距較大的圓形超級柱組成「管中管」系統，周邊柱以環梁連成框架筒，兩者經樓板共同抵抗側力。
建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。
optionsEn: In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load.
Each Petronas tower combines a reinforced concrete core of about 23 m × 23 m with a ring of widely spaced circular super columns in a tube-in-tube system.
The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure.
quiz.explanation: 雙子星塔每座塔以約 23 m × 23 m 的鋼筋混凝土核心筒，加上一圈間距較大的圓形超級柱組成「管中管」系統，周邊柱以環梁連成框架筒，兩者經樓板共同抵抗側力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Each Petronas tower combines a reinforced concrete core of about 23 m × 23 m with a ring of widely spaced circular super columns in a tube-in-tube system; ring beams link the perimeter columns into a framed tube, and floors make the two work together against lateral load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「核心筒與周邊柱環」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core and perimeter column ring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：有效慣性矩比較：核心 23 m 見方、牆厚 0.75 m，I_core = (23⁴ − 21.5⁴)/12 ≈ 5,514 m⁴；16 支直徑 2.4 m 圓柱位於半徑 22 m 圓周，完全共同作用時 I = A·n·R²/2 = 4.52×16×22²/2 ≈ 17,500 m⁴，若環梁柔度使效率 η = 0.3，有效 I ≈ 5,250 m⁴，周邊分擔約 49%；η = 0.5 時約 61%。柱數與尺寸為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Effective inertia comparison: a 23 m square core with 0.75 m walls has I_core = (23⁴ − 21.5⁴)/12 ≈ 5,514 m⁴; 16 columns of 2.4 m diameter on a 22 m radius would give I = A·n·R²/2 = 4.52×16×22²/2 ≈ 17,500 m⁴ if fully composite, but with ring-beam flexibility limiting efficiency to η = 0.3 the effective I is about 5,250 m⁴ and the perimeter share about 49%, rising to about 61% at η = 0.5. Column count and size are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在三維模型中改變環梁斷面，輸出周邊框架筒分擔的傾覆彎矩與柱軸力分布，確認翼面中央柱與角部柱的軸力比（剪力滯後程度）；再把混凝土開裂後的有效勁度折減納入，比較頂層變位與週期是否仍符合要求。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Vary ring-beam sections in the three-dimensional model, output the overturning share of the perimeter tube and the distribution of column axial forces, and confirm the axial ratio between mid-flange and corner columns, which measures shear lag; then include cracked-section stiffness reductions and check that top drift and period still meet the requirements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Column count and size are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Effective inertia comparison: a 23 m square core with 0.75 m walls has I_core = (23⁴ − 21.5⁴)/12 ≈ 5,514 m⁴; 16 columns of 2.4 m diameter on a 22 m radius would give I = A·n·R²/2 = 4.52×16×22²/2 ≈ 17,500 m⁴ if fully composite, but with ring-beam flexibility limiting efficiency to η = 0.3 the effective I is about 5,250 m⁴ and the perimeter share about 49%, rising to about 61% at η = 0.5. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「核心筒與周邊柱環」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core and perimeter column ring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在三維模型中改變環梁斷面，輸出周邊框架筒分擔的傾覆彎矩與柱軸力分布，確認翼面中央柱與角部柱的軸力比（剪力滯後程度）；再把混凝土開裂後的有效勁度折減納入，比較頂層變位與週期是否仍符合要求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Vary ring-beam sections in the three-dimensional model, output the overturning share of the perimeter tube and the distribution of column axial forces, and confirm the axial ratio between mid-flange and corner columns, which measures shear lag; then include cracked-section stiffness reductions and check that top drift and period still meet the requirements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：環梁的開孔、續接與配筋列為結構關鍵項目，機電穿孔必須在設計階段定位並補強，施工中任何新增開孔都需結構工程師書面同意。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat ring-beam openings, splices and reinforcement as critical structural items; locate and reinforce service penetrations at the design stage, and require the structural engineer's written approval for any new opening during construction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若環梁在設計中被當成剛接而實際開裂後勁度大減，周邊框架筒的貢獻被高估，核心筒承受的彎矩與變位都會超過預期；管線為穿越環梁而開大孔，也會削弱框架筒的作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If ring beams are modelled as rigid but lose much of their stiffness once cracked, the perimeter tube's contribution is overestimated and the core sees more moment and drift than expected; large service openings cut through ring beams also weaken the framed-tube action. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在三維模型中改變環梁斷面，輸出周邊框架筒分擔的傾覆彎矩與柱軸力分布，確認翼面中央柱與角部柱的軸力比（剪力滯後程度）；再把混凝土開裂後的有效勁度折減納入，比較頂層變位與週期是否仍符合要求。
knowledge.textEn: Vary ring-beam sections in the three-dimensional model, output the overturning share of the perimeter tube and the distribution of column axial forces, and confirm the axial ratio between mid-flange and corner columns, which measures shear lag; then include cracked-section stiffness reductions and check that top drift and period still meet the requirements.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 環梁的開孔、續接與配筋列為結構關鍵項目，機電穿孔必須在設計階段定位並補強，施工中任何新增開孔都需結構工程師書面同意。
knowledge.textEn: Treat ring-beam openings, splices and reinforcement as critical structural items; locate and reinforce service penetrations at the design stage, and require the structural engineer's written approval for any new opening during construction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube"?
options: 在三維模型中改變環梁斷面，輸出周邊框架筒分擔的傾覆彎矩與柱軸力分布，確認翼面中央柱與角部柱的軸力比（剪力滯後程度）。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩座相同的塔在風中會同步擺動，所以空橋不需要容許相對位移。
optionsEn: Vary ring-beam sections in the three-dimensional model, output the overturning share of the perimeter tube and the distribution of column axial forces, and confirm the axial ratio between mid-flange and corner columns, which measures shear lag.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Two identical towers sway in step in the wind, so the skybridge needs no allowance for relative movement.
quiz.explanation: 在三維模型中改變環梁斷面，輸出周邊框架筒分擔的傾覆彎矩與柱軸力分布，確認翼面中央柱與角部柱的軸力比（剪力滯後程度）；再把混凝土開裂後的有效勁度折減納入，比較頂層變位與週期是否仍符合要求。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Vary ring-beam sections in the three-dimensional model, output the overturning share of the perimeter tube and the distribution of column axial forces, and confirm the axial ratio between mid-flange and corner columns, which measures shear lag; then include cracked-section stiffness reductions and check that top drift and period still meet the requirements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「核心筒與周邊柱環」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core and perimeter column ring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若環梁在設計中被當成剛接而實際開裂後勁度大減，周邊框架筒的貢獻被高估，核心筒承受的彎矩與變位都會超過預期；管線為穿越環梁而開大孔，也會削弱框架筒的作用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If ring beams are modelled as rigid but lose much of their stiffness once cracked, the perimeter tube's contribution is overestimated and the core sees more moment and drift than expected; large service openings cut through ring beams also weaken the framed-tube action. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：選擇混凝土而非鋼構，部分原因是當時鋼材需進口、成本高，而高強度混凝土是在地承包商熟悉的材料。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Concrete rather than steel was chosen partly because steel then had to be imported at high cost, while high-strength concrete was familiar to local contractors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管中管系統中，外圈柱只負責重力，側力全由核心承擔。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "In a tube-in-tube system the outer columns carry only gravity and the core takes all lateral load." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若環梁在設計中被當成剛接而實際開裂後勁度大減，周邊框架筒的貢獻被高估，核心筒承受的彎矩與變位都會超過預期；管線為穿越環梁而開大孔，也會削弱框架筒的作用。
knowledge.textEn: If ring beams are modelled as rigid but lose much of their stiffness once cracked, the perimeter tube's contribution is overestimated and the core sees more moment and drift than expected; large service openings cut through ring beams also weaken the framed-tube action.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高強度混凝土管中管的側力分工」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lateral load sharing in a high-strength concrete tube-in-tube" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若環梁在設計中被當成剛接而實際開裂後勁度大減，周邊框架筒的貢獻被高估，核心筒承受的彎矩與變位都會超過預期；管線為穿越環梁而開大孔，也會削弱框架筒的作用。
建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If ring beams are modelled as rigid but lose much of their stiffness once cracked, the perimeter tube's contribution is overestimated and the core sees more moment and drift than expected.
The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure.
quiz.explanation: 若環梁在設計中被當成剛接而實際開裂後勁度大減，周邊框架筒的貢獻被高估，核心筒承受的彎矩與變位都會超過預期；管線為穿越環梁而開大孔，也會削弱框架筒的作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If ring beams are modelled as rigid but lose much of their stiffness once cracked, the perimeter tube's contribution is overestimated and the core sees more moment and drift than expected; large service openings cut through ring beams also weaken the framed-tube action. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 以重量換取低加速度：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Trading weight for low acceleration: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土質量與風振」如何影響吉隆坡雙子星塔的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete mass and wind sway” governs force, deformation or durability in “Petronas Twin Towers”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 公開資料指出，高強度混凝土在降低擺動上的效果約為鋼材的兩倍，但也讓建築約重一倍；建築師的資料記載每座塔約重 300,000 公噸。對風致振動而言，加速度與參與振動的質量成反比，而混凝土結構的固有阻尼通常也比鋼構略高，兩者都讓居住者感受到的晃動減少。代價是基礎必須承受更大的重力，地震時的慣性力也隨質量增加，因此重量帶來的好處只在風控制設計時成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「混凝土質量與風振」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Public sources note that high-strength concrete is about twice as effective as steel in reducing sway but makes the building about twice as heavy; the architect's figures give each tower a weight of about 300,000 t. For wind-induced vibration, acceleration is inversely proportional to the participating mass, and concrete structures usually have slightly higher inherent damping than steel, both reducing the motion occupants feel. The price is heavier gravity loads on the foundations and larger inertia forces in earthquakes, so the benefit of weight holds only where wind governs the design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Concrete mass and wind sway” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相同風力頻譜下，共振加速度約與 1/(M·√ζ) 成正比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Under the same wind-force spectrum, resonant acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/(M·√ζ).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「混凝土質量與風振」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Concrete mass and wind sway”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 以重量換取低加速度
knowledge.text: 公開資料指出，高強度混凝土在降低擺動上的效果約為鋼材的兩倍，但也讓建築約重一倍；建築師的資料記載每座塔約重 300,000 公噸。對風致振動而言，加速度與參與振動的質量成反比，而混凝土結構的固有阻尼通常也比鋼構略高，兩者都讓居住者感受到的晃動減少。
knowledge.textEn: Public sources note that high-strength concrete is about twice as effective as steel in reducing sway but makes the building about twice as heavy; the architect's figures give each tower a weight of about 300,000 t. For wind-induced vibration, acceleration is inversely proportional to the participating mass, and concrete structures usually have slightly higher inherent damping than steel, both reducing the motion occupants feel.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「以重量換取低加速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trading weight for low acceleration" is correct?
options: 建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。
高強度混凝土比一般混凝土更有韌性，所以不需要額外圍束。
公開資料指出，高強度混凝土在降低擺動上的效果約為鋼材的兩倍，但也讓建築約重一倍；建築師的資料記載每座塔約重 300,000 公噸。
optionsEn: The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure.
High-strength concrete is tougher than ordinary concrete, so it needs no extra confinement.
Public sources note that high-strength concrete is about twice as effective as steel in reducing sway but makes the building about twice as heavy.
quiz.explanation: 公開資料指出，高強度混凝土在降低擺動上的效果約為鋼材的兩倍，但也讓建築約重一倍；建築師的資料記載每座塔約重 300,000 公噸。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Public sources note that high-strength concrete is about twice as effective as steel in reducing sway but makes the building about twice as heavy; the architect's figures give each tower a weight of about 300,000 t. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 以重量換取低加速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trading weight for low acceleration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土質量與風振」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete mass and wind sway” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：相同風力頻譜下，共振加速度約與 1/(M·√ζ) 成正比。鋼構方案 M = 200,000 t、ζ = 1.5%，混凝土方案 M = 300,000 t、ζ = 2%：加速度比 = (200,000×√0.015)/(300,000×√0.02) ≈ 24,495/42,426 ≈ 0.58，即混凝土塔的加速度約為鋼構塔的 58%（未計週期差異）。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Under the same wind-force spectrum, resonant acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/(M·√ζ). For a steel scheme with M = 200,000 t and ζ = 1.5% versus a concrete scheme with M = 300,000 t and ζ = 2%, the acceleration ratio is (200,000×√0.015)/(300,000×√0.02) ≈ 24,495/42,426 ≈ 0.58, so the concrete tower sees about 58% of the steel tower's acceleration, ignoring period differences. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以風洞力平衡或氣動彈性試驗取得兩種結構方案的頂層加速度，與居住性準則比較；完工後以環境振動量測實際頻率與阻尼比，確認設計假設的阻尼值不是過度樂觀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain top-floor accelerations for both structural schemes from force-balance or aeroelastic wind-tunnel tests and compare them with habitability criteria; after completion measure the actual frequencies and damping by ambient vibration to confirm the assumed damping was not optimistic.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 相同風力頻譜下，共振加速度約與 1/(M·√ζ) 成正比。鋼構方案 M = 200,000 t、ζ = 1.5%，混凝土方案 M = 300,000 t、ζ = 2%：加速度比 = (200,000×√0.015)/(300,000×√0.02) ≈ 24,495/42,426 ≈ 0.58，即混凝土塔的加速度約為鋼構塔的 58%（未計週期差異）。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Under the same wind-force spectrum, resonant acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/(M·√ζ). For a steel scheme with M = 200,000 t and ζ = 1.5% versus a concrete scheme with M = 300,000 t and ζ = 2%, the acceleration ratio is (200,000×√0.015)/(300,000×√0.02) ≈ 24,495/42,426 ≈ 0.58, so the concrete tower sees about 58% of the steel tower's acceleration, ignoring period differences. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「以重量換取低加速度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trading weight for low acceleration", which statement holds?
options: 相同風力頻譜下，共振加速度約與 1/(M·√ζ) 成正比。
只要把樁打得夠深，地質條件的差異就不重要。
只要大多數試體合格，偶爾幾組不合格可以忽略。
optionsEn: Under the same wind-force spectrum, resonant acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/(M·√ζ).
If piles are driven deep enough, differences in ground conditions do not matter.
If most specimens pass, an occasional failing set can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 相同風力頻譜下，共振加速度約與 1/(M·√ζ) 成正比。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Under the same wind-force spectrum, resonant acceleration is roughly proportional to 1/(M·√ζ). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 以重量換取低加速度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trading weight for low acceleration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土質量與風振」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete mass and wind sway” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以風洞力平衡或氣動彈性試驗取得兩種結構方案的頂層加速度，與居住性準則比較；完工後以環境振動量測實際頻率與阻尼比，確認設計假設的阻尼值不是過度樂觀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain top-floor accelerations for both structural schemes from force-balance or aeroelastic wind-tunnel tests and compare them with habitability criteria; after completion measure the actual frequencies and damping by ambient vibration to confirm the assumed damping was not optimistic. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構方案比選時，應同時列出重量、基礎需求、風致加速度與地震力四項，讓業主看清取捨；阻尼假設要引用實測資料或文獻範圍，並在交接時提供實測值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When comparing structural schemes, tabulate weight, foundation demand, wind acceleration and seismic force together so the owner sees the trade-offs; base damping assumptions on measured data or published ranges, and hand over the measured values at completion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若設計時把混凝土阻尼取得過高，而完工實測阻尼較低，強風時加速度可能超出舒適度門檻；增加的質量若未在基礎與地震分析中完整計入，會低估樁的承載需求與地震力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If concrete damping is assumed too high in design and the measured value proves lower, accelerations can exceed comfort limits in strong winds; if the added mass is not fully carried into the foundation and seismic analyses, pile demands and earthquake forces are underestimated. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以風洞力平衡或氣動彈性試驗取得兩種結構方案的頂層加速度，與居住性準則比較；完工後以環境振動量測實際頻率與阻尼比，確認設計假設的阻尼值不是過度樂觀。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain top-floor accelerations for both structural schemes from force-balance or aeroelastic wind-tunnel tests and compare them with habitability criteria; after completion measure the actual frequencies and damping by ambient vibration to confirm the assumed damping was not optimistic.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構方案比選時，應同時列出重量、基礎需求、風致加速度與地震力四項，讓業主看清取捨；阻尼假設要引用實測資料或文獻範圍，並在交接時提供實測值。
knowledge.textEn: When comparing structural schemes, tabulate weight, foundation demand, wind acceleration and seismic force together so the owner sees the trade-offs; base damping assumptions on measured data or published ranges, and hand over the measured values at completion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「以重量換取低加速度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Trading weight for low acceleration"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以風洞力平衡或氣動彈性試驗取得兩種結構方案的頂層加速度，與居住性準則比較；完工後以環境振動量測實際頻率與阻尼比，確認設計假設的阻尼值不是過度樂觀。
不鏽鋼不會生鏽，所以外牆金屬件不需要維護。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.
Obtain top-floor accelerations for both structural schemes from force-balance or aeroelastic wind-tunnel tests and compare them with habitability criteria.
Stainless steel never rusts, so façade metalwork needs no maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 以風洞力平衡或氣動彈性試驗取得兩種結構方案的頂層加速度，與居住性準則比較；完工後以環境振動量測實際頻率與阻尼比，確認設計假設的阻尼值不是過度樂觀。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain top-floor accelerations for both structural schemes from force-balance or aeroelastic wind-tunnel tests and compare them with habitability criteria; after completion measure the actual frequencies and damping by ambient vibration to confirm the assumed damping was not optimistic. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 以重量換取低加速度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Trading weight for low acceleration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混凝土質量與風振」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete mass and wind sway” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若設計時把混凝土阻尼取得過高，而完工實測阻尼較低，強風時加速度可能超出舒適度門檻；增加的質量若未在基礎與地震分析中完整計入，會低估樁的承載需求與地震力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If concrete damping is assumed too high in design and the measured value proves lower, accelerations can exceed comfort limits in strong winds; if the added mass is not fully carried into the foundation and seismic analyses, pile demands and earthquake forces are underestimated. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：代價是基礎必須承受更大的重力，地震時的慣性力也隨質量增加，因此重量帶來的好處只在風控制設計時成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The price is heavier gravity loads on the foundations and larger inertia forces in earthquakes, so the benefit of weight holds only where wind governs the design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「建築越輕越好，重量對結構只有壞處。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The lighter a building the better; weight is always bad for a structure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若設計時把混凝土阻尼取得過高，而完工實測阻尼較低，強風時加速度可能超出舒適度門檻；增加的質量若未在基礎與地震分析中完整計入，會低估樁的承載需求與地震力。
knowledge.textEn: If concrete damping is assumed too high in design and the measured value proves lower, accelerations can exceed comfort limits in strong winds; if the added mass is not fully carried into the foundation and seismic analyses, pile demands and earthquake forces are underestimated.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「以重量換取低加速度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Trading weight for low acceleration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
High-strength concrete is tougher than ordinary concrete, so it needs no extra confinement.
